subject: SS
title: Writing, artifacts and exchange
teach: Hieroglyphics is the classroom term for Egyptian writing using hieroglyphs. Signs could represent sounds or words; it was not simply an English letter-for-picture code.
Papyrus is a Nile plant and the paper-like writing material made from its stems. Scribes used writing skills to record information. Writing is a system of signs; papyrus is a material.

The Rosetta Stone contains three scripts: hieroglyphic, demotic and Greek, using two languages. The assigned text simplifies this incorrectly. Comparing the same message helped scholars decipher the writing.
An artifact is an object made or changed by people. Artifacts can provide evidence about tools, skills, beliefs or daily life, depending on their context.
A sphinx combines a human head and a lion’s body. The Great Sphinx stands at Giza, near the pyramid complex of Khafre. It is not in the Valley of the Kings, despite the textbook’s incorrect location.
An artifact’s shape or location supports some claims but not every claim. A royal monument can express power without representing how every Egyptian lived.
Commerce means buying, selling or exchanging goods. Egypt and Nubia traded resources, including grain and gold. Interdependence means groups depend on one another.

Cultural diffusion is the spread of ideas, knowledge, customs or styles between groups. It can occur through contact and trade, and also through migration or conquest; it is not limited to peaceful exchange.
Nubia had its own societies, rulers and traditions. Similarities with Egypt do not make the two societies identical. Nubian rulers later ruled Egypt, and Meroe became an important Nubian center.

The writing system is always the paper itself.
The page material determines every word’s meaning.
repair.teach: Hieroglyphics is the classroom term for Egyptian writing using hieroglyphs. Signs could represent sounds or words; it was not simply an English letter-for-picture code. Papyrus is a Nile plant and the paper-like writing material made from its stems. Scribes used writing skills to record information. Writing is a system of signs; papyrus is a material. The Rosetta Stone contains three scripts: hieroglyphic, demotic and Greek, using two languages. The assigned text simplifies this incorrectly. Comparing the same message helped scholars decipher the writing.
repair.rationale: Correct: The writing system and the surface have different functions. A writing system and a writing material are different, just as an alphabet and a sheet of paper are different today. The comparison helps identify functions; it does not make ancient writing identical to English.
